plugins.name: material-ui
plugins.description: Material UI agent skills for styling (sx, styled, theme overrides, global CSS), theming and design tokens (createTheme, colorSchemes, CSS variables), Next.js App/Pages Router integration, and Tailwind CSS v4/v3 interoperability, plus the official mui-mcp server for docs and code examples. Use when building or customizing @mui/material UI.
